site.name: JBERRY2347 Apps
site.tagline: Every app I've built, in one place.

apps.name: CueSight
apps.description: On-device facial expression, micro-expression and voice-cue reader with a guided baseline, truth/lie calibration and a built-in trainer. A cue reader, not a lie detector.

apps.name: Hold the Line
apps.description: A team-vs-team bluffing party game built on live composure/tell reading. Keep your planted lies alive while the other team watches your tells. Play in one room or online from separate devices.

apps.name: VocalForge
apps.description: Type lyrics, pick a voice and a style, and get them sung: a full song with backing music, an a cappella vocal to drop on your own beat, or an instrumental. Uses the ElevenLabs Music API with your own key, which never leaves your browser.
